Mrs. Crowley’s, X:8

This is the official :) version taught by my very good friend Joan Crowley in 1977. I still have the hand-written notes of this and many more tunes I learned that year in the quiet afternoon hours in Crowley’s Bar, Kenmare.
She was such a wonderful person, thanks for posting the lovely polka I didn’t have a name for.

↳ Posted by shanachie on February 25th, 2025.
